set.body: Ravel remains the sole dense storage/layout authority, but owned NDArray and MutableNDArray currently expose only fully checked indexed access. Scala.js half-flow composition regressed from the historical 6 ms receipt to 22-25 ms at 32^3 even after canonical flat Ravel views; copying to platform buffers or retaining raw parallel arrays is forbidden. Add a certified whole-canonical contiguous access/kernel contract inside Ravel that preserves owned immutability, mutable destination discipline, JVM/JS primitive specialization, and no raw storage escape. Migrate image4s/ScalaFIM hot kernels to it. Acceptance: exact semantic/layout parity; zero full-volume construction per operation; JVM <=64 B/logical op; current-machine Scala.js matched workload within 10% of a same-run primitive planar oracle or otherwise an explicitly ratified visible loss; no second dense owner or wrapper hierarchy.
set.title: Add certified contiguous Ravel access for image kernels
